label: HL-L2350DW compact mono laser printer
description: Compact A4 mono laser printer, 30ppm with automatic duplex, that is wireless-only: its sole network port is an 802.11b/g/n radio, with Ethernet deliberately absent from this chassis.

label: LaserJet Pro M404dn mono laser printer
description: Workgroup mono laser printer rated 38-40ppm with automatic duplex, wired-only networking over a single Gigabit Ethernet port and no wireless radio.

label: i-SENSYS MF445dw mono laser MFP
description: Mono laser multifunction (print/copy/scan/fax) at 38ppm with duplex ADF, offering Gigabit Ethernet plus 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi with direct connection.

label: VersaLink C405 colour laser MFP
description: Colour laser multifunction at 35ppm with a 50-sheet single-pass duplex ADF, networked through a single 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet port (Wi-Fi needs the optional kit).

label: Color LaserJet Pro MFP M479fdw colour laser MFP
description: Colour laser multifunction at 28ppm with duplex ADF, fax and 4.3-inch touchscreen, networked via Gigabit Ethernet or 802.11b/g/n dual-band Wi-Fi.

label: EcoTank ET-4850 inkjet all-in-one
description: Refillable-tank colour inkjet all-in-one with ADF, fax and duplex printing, connecting over Fast Ethernet (10/100 Mbps) or 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi with Wi-Fi Direct.

label: EcoTank ET-2850 inkjet all-in-one
description: Consumer refillable-tank colour inkjet all-in-one with duplex printing that ships with wireless only: 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi Direct, no Ethernet port at all.

label: ZD421 desktop thermal label printer
description: Desktop 4-inch direct-thermal/thermal-transfer label printer up to 6ips, with a 10/100 Ethernet module (field-installable 802.11ac Wi-Fi is the alternative option).

label: QL-820NWB network label printer
description: Desktop label printer for DK rolls up to 62mm with cutter, black/red printing, LCD and AirPrint, wired via 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX Ethernet and also 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi.

label: TM-m30III mPOS receipt printer
description: Compact 80mm thermal receipt printer at 300mm/s for mPOS, with a 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX Ethernet port on the standard model; the Wi-Fi + Bluetooth variant uses its radio instead of the LAN port.

label: TM-T88VII thermal receipt printer
description: High-speed 500mm/s 80mm thermal receipt printer with built-in 10/100Base-T/TX Ethernet and USB, where Wi-Fi is only added via an optional USB wireless dongle.

label: TSP143IV thermal receipt printer
description: 80mm thermal receipt printer for POS at 250mm/s with CloudPRNT, whose X4 models combine a 10BASE-T/100Base-TX LAN port with WLAN and Bluetooth radios.

label: SureColor T5170 36-inch large-format printer
description: 36-inch wide-format pigment-ink plotter producing an A1/D-size print in 31 seconds, networked over Gigabit Ethernet (1000Base-T/100Base-TX/10Base-T) plus 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi Direct.
